nodes.speaker: Bernard
nodes.text: That manager's wearing a groove in the floor.

nodes.speaker: Bernard
nodes.text: Three times to the front door since I sat down. Checking the weather, I suppose. It isn't raining.

nodes.speaker: Bernard
nodes.text: Forty minutes. They've got a machine for tea. I've seen it. Nobody's offered.

nodes.speaker: Bernard
nodes.text: Do what they say. Don't be brave. Brave is for films.

nodes.speaker: Bernard
nodes.text: Keep your head down, son. Nothing to see. Nothing to see.
